newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.

text.p: All contracts of Tokyo corn futures ended higher on Thursday due to active buying by local investors, who were encouraged by bullish sentiment in the soybean market, traders said.
Prices were 30 to 380 yen higher, with the benchmark March 1998 contract up 350 yen at 16,670 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 45,050 lots.
Active buying from individual investors pushed up all months from the opening, traders said. Distant months, in particular, extended gains in the afternoon due to fresh buying orders, they said.
